source: Library of Congress, Sanborn Fire Insurance Map, St. Louis Vol. 12 (1938), sheet 67, image 04858_12_1938-0067
labeled_by: Claude draft from the LOC sheet image, 2026-10-13; NOT yet checked by Baburaj
scope: Industrial, fuel, tank and vehicle-service uses, plus stores and warehouses for paint, hardware or building materials, plus every G.T. symbol. Excludes dwellings, general stores and flats, offices, clinics, banks, post offices, general/grocery/furniture/merchandise storage, and auto houses (A) with no other use. Groups (a field of tanks) are one entry.

definitions.gasoline_tank_count: Number of tanks the map labels as gasoline: G.T. / G.T.S. symbols, 'GASOL. STGE. TKS.', or a labeled gasoline tank. 0 means none drawn.
definitions.other_tanks: Tanks that are not labeled gasoline (water, grain, iron, fuel oil, etc.).
definitions.map_notes: Only what is printed on the sheet.
definitions.interpretation: Inference, not a map fact; never scored.

sheet_layout: Scale 100 ft to an inch. E Primm at top to E Espenschied at bottom; Vulcan St on the left, Mississippi River on the right. Rail lines run north-south through the middle. Inset (lower left) continues the grain elevator.
out_of_scope_seen: Dwellings on Vulcan St, Reilly Av, E Marceau and Van Buren
Frame dwellings on frame foundations (FR. FOUND'N) east of the tracks
(ASB. CL.) OFF.: asbestos-clad office of the shipyard, a building material, not a use

verification.method: Claude read every block of the full-resolution image. To approve: check each entry and the G.T. counts against the map, then set status to human_verified.

buildings.label: ST. LOUIS SULPHUR & CHEM. CO. / SULPHUR MILL / SACKING
buildings.map_notes: Corner of Vulcan St. SACKING bldg (CONC. FL., STEEL FR.), SULPHUR MILL, ST'GE, FURN. HO., OFF. Watchman with clock; heat: stove; power: elec.

buildings.label: EAGLE IRON WORKS
buildings.map_notes: FACTY. BLDG.; no watchman, heat: stove in off., power: elec. Rail spur to the building. IRON W. HO. nearby.

buildings.label: MISSOURI PACIFIC R.R. CO. GRAIN ELEVATOR / BOILER HO.
buildings.use: grain elevator (Continental Grain Co.) with boiler house
buildings.map_notes: GRAIN TKS. 102' HIGH; capacity 4,000,000 bu. BOILER HO. BUILT 1930. Inset continues it.

buildings.label: CONTRACTOR'S YARD
buildings.map_notes: IR. SAND HOPPERS, IR. STGE. East of the tracks, by the river.

buildings.label: ST. LOUIS SHIP BUILDING & STEEL CO. / SHIP YARDS
buildings.map_notes: BOAT WAYS to the river, CONVERTOR HO. (EARTH FL.), GEN'L ST'GE., OFF. Watchman, no clock; heat: stove; power: elec.
buildings.interpretation: Shipyards used paints, solvents and metals.

notes: 520 E Marceau is a flat (F.). The week 4-5 reader reported a DRY CLEANING there; nothing like it is printed on the sheet.
